versions.changelog:
- Initial release of workbuddy-skin: a Windows desktop skin studio for WorkBuddy (Tauri v2 + Rust).
- Provides workflow for building, modifying, debugging, and publishing WorkBuddy skin packages.
- Uses assets/wb-skin-studio/ as a reusable Tauri v2 template; development should occur in user workspace copies.
- Supports theme selection/application, skin pausing, and status/error feedback within the UI.
- Handles custom skin enablement via src/skin-unlock_cy.js and restricts resource access and CDP connections for security.
- Explicit guidelines for packaging, resource mapping, and safe distribution without modifying WorkBuddy installation files.
